powers.name: Lightning bolt
powers.blurb: a single white-hot bolt from a clear sky, aimed at one target

powers.name: Storm clouds
powers.blurb: a lid of black clouds rolls over a region: rain, wind, dread

powers.name: Volcano
powers.blurb: the ground splits and a volcano rises where there was none, raining ash and fire

powers.name: Earthquake
powers.blurb: the earth bucks like a startled horse; towers sway and fall

powers.name: Flood
powers.blurb: rivers jump their banks and the sea walks inland

powers.name: Wildfire
powers.blurb: a wall of fire runs across the land faster than people can

powers.name: Meteor
powers.blurb: a burning rock from space, aimed with terrible precision

powers.name: Raise land
powers.blurb: a new mountain range or island heaves itself up out of the ground or the sea

powers.name: Sink land
powers.blurb: the land drops and the sea pours in; a coast becomes a bay

powers.name: Grow forest
powers.blurb: an ancient forest erupts in hours, swallowing roads and buildings

powers.name: Swarm
powers.blurb: a black cloud of locusts, bats or worse descends
